scope: internal held-out analysis intents from previously inspected development data
rule: within fixed semantic strata, sort SHA256(seed:source_group); select fixed test_count

tasks.intent: Sum lineitem quantities separately for each return flag. Return rows sorted by return flag.
Count lineitems whose ship mode is AIR.
Join customers to orders and sum order total price for each customer market segment. Sort by segment.
For each order priority, find its most expensive order. Break price ties by smallest order key. Return priority, order key, price, sorted by priority.
Find the sum of explained variance ratios of the first 5 principal components, using full SVD.
Cluster the observations into 8 groups using KMeans with random_state=42 and n_init=10. Report inertia.
Use logistic regression (C=1, max_iter=200, random_state=42) to classify the data. Use the fixed stratified 25% test split, random_state=42. Report test accuracy.
Estimate ridge regression generalization with alpha=1.0, five shuffled KFold splits, random_state=42. Report mean negative mean squared error and all fold scores.
Estimate a 200-tree random forest classifier with five shuffled stratified folds, random_state=42. Report mean accuracy and all fold accuracies.
Estimate histogram gradient boosting classification with max_iter=200 and five shuffled stratified folds, random_state=42. Report mean accuracy and fold accuracies.
Estimate RBF support-vector classification (C=1) with five shuffled stratified folds, random_state=42. Report mean accuracy and fold accuracies.
Estimate an extra-trees classifier with 300 trees and five shuffled stratified folds, random_state=42. Report mean accuracy and fold accuracies.
Fill missing values by each column median. Report fill values, missing counts and resulting column means.
Find the 90th percentile of column 1 using linear interpolation.
Compute value column 1 weighted by column 2 within each integer group in column 0; sort groups.
Compute the Pearson correlation matrix of columns 0, 1 and 2.
Deduplicate on columns 0 and 1, keeping the first row. Report retained row count and sum of column 2 on retained rows.
Count column 0 values in 8 equal-width bins over [-4,4], using numpy histogram endpoint conventions.
Test independence of categorical columns 0 and 1 using Pearson chi-square without continuity correction. Return statistic, pvalue and degrees of freedom.
Estimate a 95% percentile bootstrap confidence interval for the mean of column 0 using 1000 resamples and RNG seed 42. Return sample mean and interval endpoints.
Test mean difference of column 0 between y=0 and y=1 with 1000 random label permutations, seed 42. Use two-sided absolute differences and plus-one pvalue; report difference group 0 minus 1.
Perform a two-sided paired t test of column 0 minus column 1; report statistic and pvalue.
Perform one-way ANOVA of column 1 across categorical groups in column 0; report statistic and pvalue.
Perform a two-sided asymptotic Mann-Whitney U test comparing columns 0 and 1, with continuity correction; report statistic and pvalue.
Fit unregularized OLS of y on column 0 with intercept. Report slope, intercept and R squared.
Count column 0 observations outside Tukey fences Q1-1.5*IQR and Q3+1.5*IQR; report count and fraction.
For each sorted left timestamp X[:,0], match the latest right timestamp y no later than it. Right values are X[:,1]. Report matched count, matched value sum and first 5 matched values.
Compute trailing 51-sample rolling means of column 0, keeping valid windows only. Report count, mean, minimum and maximum of these means.
Aggregate values X[:,1] into 60-second buckets floor(X[:,0]/60)*60. Report number of occupied buckets and first 5 sorted bucket sums.
Sessionize sorted events X[:,0]: a gap greater than 30 starts a new session. Return session count, mean events per session and maximum last-minus-first duration.
Use linear interpolation of finite values X[:,1] at times X[:,0] to evaluate query times y. Report query count, first 5 values and mean over all queries.
For column 0 sampled at 128 Hz, find the dominant positive FFT frequency after centering, and its fraction of all non-DC power.
Find signed lag maximizing full cross-correlation of centered X[:,0] with centered X[:,1], restricting absolute lag to 100.
Apply order-4 zero-phase Butterworth low-pass to column 0 with 10 Hz cutoff at 100 Hz sample rate. Report filtered mean and RMS.
Detect peaks in column 0 with minimum distance 50 samples and prominence 0.8. Return count, first 5 indices and mean peak height.
Integrate X[:,1] against nonuniform sample positions X[:,0] using the trapezoid rule.
Find the real polynomial root in [0,2]. Descending coefficients are X[:,0]. Return root and polynomial residual.
Minimize 0.5*w.T*X*w+y.T*w subject to sum(w)=1 and each weight in [0,1]. Report optimal objective and weight sum.
Solve a tridiagonal system: X columns 0/1/2 are lower/main/upper diagonals, y is RHS. Add 0.5 to the main diagonal. Return solution mean, Euclidean norm and max absolute residual.
Fit rank-6 NMF to nonnegative X, random initialization seed 42, coordinate descent, tol=1e-4, max_iter=200. Report Frobenius reconstruction error.
Separate 5 independent components using FastICA, unit-variance whitening, seed 42, tol=1e-4, max_iter=300. Report mean absolute excess kurtosis (biased estimator) across recovered signals.
Apply Euclidean DBSCAN with eps=0.65 and min_samples=8. Return non-noise cluster count, noise count and largest cluster size.

Use the first 1000 X rows as queries and remaining rows as training points. Find exact 5 nearest Euclidean neighbors. Report mean fifth distance and nearest training-relative index for the first 5 queries.
Fit IsolationForest with 100 estimators, contamination=0.05, seed 42, single job. Return number with negative decision score and mean decision score.
Estimate classification mutual information of every X column against y using 3 neighbors, seed 42. Return values and top 3 feature indices in descending order, ties by column index.
Fit OLS AR(8) with intercept to X[:,0], then recursively forecast the next 5 values. Return forecast array.
Estimate Kaplan-Meier survival from X[:,0] durations and X[:,1] event indicators. Report survival at time 3 and first event time when survival reaches 0.5 or below.
Treat X as a binary image. Label 4-neighbor connected foreground regions, retain those with at least 8 pixels, and report region count and largest size.
Find the minimum-cost one-to-one assignment of rows to columns in square cost matrix X. Return total cost and assigned count.
Compute the order-1 Wasserstein distance between equally weighted empirical samples in columns 0 and 1.
